lead.title: Diagnexia picks Sectra’s cloud platform for up to 100,000 NHS pathology cases a year
lead.deck: The UK digital pathology provider, a partner to more than 30 NHS organizations with over 250 specialist pathologists, will use Sectra’s Image Exchange Portal to receive, send and report cases. The contract renews annually and targets up to 100,000 cases in year one; its value was not disclosed.

milestone.title: Encare signs with Thailand’s National Cancer Institute to roll out ERAS in colorectal surgery
milestone.summary: NCI Thailand’s colorectal team joins the ERAS Implementation Program and uses Encare’s ERAS Interactive Audit System (EIAS) to track guideline adherence and clinical outcomes; it aims for ERAS Society qualification.
milestone.why: Stockholm-based Encare already works with more than 140 hospitals in over 30 countries: clinical audit software tied to a recognized protocol, exported hospital by hospital.

brefsIntl.title: The AMA releases a governance framework for agentic AI solutions in healthcare
brefsIntl.summary: The American physicians’ association framework governs the deployment of AI agents in care; a reference point for European vendors targeting the US market.

brefsIntl.title: Otter Health raises $8M for a different take on prior authorization
brefsIntl.summary: As prior authorization becomes an AI “arms race” between payers and providers, the startup launches an alternative approach backed by $8M.

word.fr: HL7 FHIR healthcare data exchange standard
word.definition: An HL7 standard that breaks health data into modular “resources” so different systems can exchange it.

parts.label: Extensions
parts.role: cover what the base resources do not

how.t: Each piece of content is a resource, with shared metadata and a human-readable narrative.
A use case combines several resources through references rather than relying on one.
A Capability Statement describes the interfaces offered; resources are represented in JSON or XML.

word.why: VC angle: it is the plumbing layer for clinical AI and the European health data space. Starting from FHIR can supply a database, APIs and sample data, saving years of development — a tools market rather than an applications market.
